name: Symphonic Warrior Disccs
text:
P
You can return 1 card you control to your hand; Special Summon this card from your Pendulum Zone. You can only use this effect of "Symphonic Warrior Disccs" once per turn.
E
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Symphonic Warrior" monster, or 1 card that mentions Symphonic Counter from your Deck to your hand, except "Symphonic Warrior Disccs". You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck face-down the turn you activate this effect except WIND Synchro Monsters. You can return this card from your field to your hand; Special Summon 1 "Symphonic Warrior" monster from your hand, GY or face-up Extra Deck. If this card is used as Synchro Material and added to your Extra Deck face-up: You can remove 3 Symphonic Counter from the field; Special Summon 1 "Symphonic Warrior" monster from your hand or GY. You can only use each effect of "Symphonic Warrior Disccs" once per turn, and cannot activate more than 1 in the same Chain.

name: Reactor Shocker
text: Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation. When your opponent activates an effect and you have a card effect in the same Chain: You can negate all other activated effects in this Chain, then, if the number of your effects in this Chain is equal to or greater than your opponent’s, draw cards equal to that number, then, if one of your effects is Chain Link 1, place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Deck. You can only use this effect of "Reactor Shocker" once per turn.
review: Not a shared activation-limit clause; refers to negating other effects in same Chain.

name: Terrarumian Venus Flytrap
text:
2+ Plant monsters, including a “Terrarumian” Pendulum Monster

● You can target 1 "Terrarumian" monster this card points to and 1 card on the field; destroy them.
